releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.28 upgrades Notes with a familiar productivity workflow: Color filter, Sort and List/Grid view controls now sit under Search, while Pin and Important remain unchanged. Note title and body now use Android English spell checking with red wavy underlines and tap-to-choose suggestions, without forced auto-correction; Arabic, numbers and mixed note content are left alone. Existing automatic Arabic/English direction, Sketch, Price Photos, local/email backup, Inbox and all previous file features are preserved.
